name: ariaDescribedBy
label: Aria describedby
description: aria-describedby Which element (by ID) provides more description for the component

name: ariaLabel
label: Aria label
description: aria-label Accessible label for the component. Only needed when the label prop is not descriptive enough on its own.

name: ariaLabelledby
label: Aria labelledby
description: aria-labelledby Which element (by ID) acts as a label for the component

name: autofocus
label: Auto-focus
description: Causes the component to receive focus as soon as it has finished mounting. When passed as a string, 'true' (case-sensitive) will be treated like boolean true.

name: enableSearch
label: Enable search
description: Enable Search on the currency Dropdown.

name: enableSubLabel
label: Enable sub-label
description: Enable Sub label on the currency Dropdown.

name: code
label: Default currency code
description: Currency Code of the value passed in

name: configAria
label: Config aria
description: The config aria property that you want to configure if label is not present.

name: currencyCodes
label: Currency codes
description: List of available currencies that the user can enter

name: decorations
label: Decorations
description: Specifies the collection of icons to display on the field label.

name: fieldLayout
label: Field layout configuration
description: Configuration for the field layout. Determines whether the labels, field and slotted content are arranged vertically or horizontally, and their respective proportion in a horizontal container.

name: helperContent
label: Helper content
description: If set, an iconic button with a popover appears next to the label to display additional hint text to the user, such as password requirements or other instructions.

name: highlightedValue
label: Highlighted value
description: The highlighted value labels that you want to display beside the field Label.

name: invalid
label: Invalid
description: Specifies whether the current value is not valid.

name: label
label: Label
description: User-visible label for the field.

name: locale
label: Locale
description: Locale in which currency should be formatted in

name: maxFractionDigits
label: Maximum fraction digits
description: Maximum number of fraction digits to show

name: minFractionDigits
label: Minimum fraction digits
description: Flag that switches between multiple and single value reference inputs

name: messages
label: Messages
description: Array of message objects that must contain type and message itself.

name: name
label: name
description: Name for the component. Any events dispatched by the component will use this name.

name: placeholder
label: Placeholder
description: Content to display when there is no suitable display value.

name: readonly
label: Readonly
description: Specifies that the user cannot modify the value of the component. When passed as a string, 'true' (case-sensitive) will be treated like boolean true.

name: size
label: Size
description: Field size of the component. NDS supports 'sm', 'md' sizes.

name: value
label: value
description: Value for the Component

name: singleCurrency
label: Single currency
description: Should be locked into using a single currency

name: required
label: Required
description: Whether or not the user must fill in a value for this component. Can be specified as a boolean or the string 'true'

name: useAllFractionsDigits
label: Use all fraction digits
description: System setting to allow all digits entered regardless of currency format

name: reversed
label: Reversed
description: Specifies that the field should be rendered right-to-left
